name: Hotel De Berri, Luxury Collection Hotel
insider_take: This intimate luxury hideaway puts you steps from the Champs-Élysées in a beautifully restored 19th-century Haussmann building that once housed Parisian aristocracy.
whats_special: Hotel De Berri occupies a prime location on Rue de Berri, originally built in 1889 and named after Charles de France, Duke of Berry. The hotel's façade features classic Haussmann architecture with wrought-iron balconies, while inside you'll find contemporary French elegance. Its position in the Golden Triangle places you within Paris's most exclusive shopping and dining district.
pro_tip: Request a room facing the courtyard for peaceful quiet in the heart of the city, and take advantage of the hotel's proximity to Galeries Lafayette and Printemps - both are just a 5-minute walk away.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you just 200 meters from the Arc de Triomphe and a short stroll to the Grand Palais. Explore the nearby Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré for world-class boutiques, or walk to Place Vendôme (10 minutes) for the ultimate luxury shopping experience. The Tuileries Garden is also within easy walking distance.
pros: Prime location near Champs-Élysées and luxury shopping
Elegant Haussmannian architecture with modern luxury amenities
Exceptional personalized service and concierge expertise
Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits and privileges
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Paris hotels
Compact room sizes characteristic of historic Parisian properties
